target_role: Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
briefing_text: Anthropic's partnership DNA is cloud-distributed, partner-enabled enterprise adoption: co-sell with GSIs and ISVs, make Claude easy to deploy through AWS and GCP channels, and turn trust, governance, and model quality into repeatable technical close. For this JD, the useful signal is not frontier research or model internals; it is partner enablement, joint solution development, reference architectures, and pilot-to-production motion that creates indirect revenue. The role exists to translate Claude into reusable partner plays for enterprise AI adoption at scale.
